# Data Retention Policy

Revision: v01. Effective: 2023-05-16. Owner: Head of Platform Engineering.

## 1. Purpose

This document sets the minimum requirements for data retention. It exists so that every team applies the same
rules the same way, and so that an auditor can check that they do.

## 2. Scope

This document applies to every employee, contractor and system of the company. Where a contract or a law imposes a stricter
requirement, the stricter requirement applies.

## 3. Definitions

- In-scope systems: every system listed in the asset register with this policy as its control set.
- Owner: the role accountable for this document and for approving exceptions to it.
- Confirmed event: an event that the response team has classified, as opposed to a report.
- Working day: Monday to Friday excluding public holidays at the registered office.

## 4. Requirements

- **R1.** Changes to in-scope systems follow the change process and are reviewed by a second person.
- **R2.** Backups of in-scope systems run at least every 24 hours and are tested quarterly.
- **R3.** Interactive sessions expire after 4 hours and require re-authentication.
- **R4.** This document is reviewed every 6 months and after any incident that invokes it.
- **R5.** Monitoring alerts are triaged within one business hour during working hours.
- **R6.** Exceptions to this policy are approved in writing by the document owner and recorded in the exception register.
- **R7.** Passwords are at least 10 characters long and are checked against a list of known compromised passwords.
- **R8.** Shared accounts are prohibited; every action is attributable to a named individual.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions are granted only where a requirement cannot be met for technical or legal reasons, are
time-limited, and are reviewed at every scheduled review of this document.

## 6. Review and ownership

The owner of this document is the Head of Platform Engineering, who approves exceptions and signs off every revision.
Material changes are communicated to all affected teams before they take effect.
